notes.content: [h1]Change log[/h1][p][b]General[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where keybindings could not be changed because of an unsigned Controller binding[/p][/*][*][p]Bows now deal tool damage in melee range[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Buildings[/b][/p][list][*][p]Removed unimplemented recipes from University[/p][/*][*][p]Added new tiles to market (see items)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Items[/b][/p][list][*][p]Changed name and ID of lobster trinket[/p][/*][*][p]Added placeable ground tiles (dirt, grass, tall grass, sand, etc.)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Dungeons & PoI's[/b][/p][list][*][p]Prevent dungeon gates from opening until all enemies are killed[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Enemies[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added new bears[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced health of small scorpion[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced health of Snakes[/p][/*][*][p]Tiny Satyrs now abandon the catapult if a threat is nearby[/p][/*][*][p]Updated broken droptables[/p][/*][*][p]Put back burning fallen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue causing goat to be stuck on ballista[/p][/*][*][p]Vultures now only aggroes if it's day[/p][/*][*][p]Changed vulture and phoenix aggro ranges[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug causing vulture to not face downwards when standing on tree[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Flora & Fauna[/b][/p][list][*][p]Mushrooms are now farmable[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]UI[/b][/p][list][*][p]Inventory slots now change colour based on rarity of the item inside it[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]...as well as additional fixes and changes![/p][p][/p][p]Happy adventuring![/p]

notes.title: Playtest Patch Notes - Alpha 0.19.1_22
notes.content: [p][i]"It's like a whooole neeew gaaame..."[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Greetings Romans! [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for your unending patience! We're finally ready to present to you the next playtest update, bringing a whole cart-centipede's worth of features and fixes![/p][p][/p][h1]IMPORTANT INFO[/h1][p]With the introduction of 0.19.1, [b]a vast majority of your previously saved items will vanish completely or become debug icons[/b], due a complete overhaul being done to item ID's, names, crafting recipes, and appearances. [/p][p]Additionally,  your [b]characters will most likely[/b] change appearance due to palettes and body type changes/additions.[/p][p][/p][p]We [b]highly[/b] recommend creating a new world and character for this reason.[/p][p]We apologize for the inconvenience, but such is the nature of playtests![/p][p][/p][h2]Change log[/h2][p][b]General[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added new player appearance options[/p][/*][*][p]Added intro cinematic[/p][/*][*][p]Added Velites as new player profession[/p][/*][*][p]Made trees only plantable on dirt tiles[/p][/*][*][p]Players can now toggle walking (CAPS LOCK by default)[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]Improved instruments audio[/p][/*][*][p]If spawn point is blocked it moves to a free space[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced programmer art with proper art[/p][/*][*][p]Updated throwing aim assist[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Buildings[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added Brick Oven[/p][/*][*][p]Added bricks as a resource[/p][/*][*][p]Catapults have been buffed[/p][/*][*][p]Catapults now deal siege damage to buildings[/p][/*][*][p]The blacksmiths level now decides what ores can be smelted[/p][/*][*][p]Altar can now be upgraded[/p][list][*][p]Players can now fast-travel between upgraded altars[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Building appearance updates[/p][/*][*][p]New recipes added to Bakery[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Constructions[/b][/p][list][*][p]Buckets are no longer consumed when building with Clay[/p][/*][*][p]Workbenches can now be carried[/p][/*][*][p]Updated construction requirements[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Items[/b][/p][list][*][p]Major balancing to all combat numbers, Items, and stats[/p][/*][*][p]Added new craftable Arrows[/p][/*][*][p]Visual overhaul for all available armours and weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Major changes to Boss-specific gear[/p][/*][*][p]Added over **65** new items to loot, craft, or equip![/p][/*][*][p]Changed a bunch of crafting recipes[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new weapon type[/p][/*][*][p]Changed max value possible of coins in inventory[/p][/*][*][p]Gem rarities set[/p][/*][*][p]Removed schematics from flora[/p][/*][*][p]Animal meat is consolidated into three tiers (small, medium, large)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Dungeons & PoI's[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added new dungeons & PoI's[/p][/*][*][p]New dungeon entrance appearances[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Satyr activity in desert[/p][/*][*][p]Changes to Medusa dungeon[/p][/*][*][p]Dungeon & PoI loot overhaul[/p][list][*][p] Themed dungeons now guarantee unique loot[/p][/*][*][p] Unique armours now drop as schematics for your crafters[/p][/*][*][p] Dungeons, PoIs, and challenge dungeons no longer share loot-tables[/p][/*][*][p] Biome specific loot tables are even more diverse and separated[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Dungeons now spawn in difficulty-appropriate biomes[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bosses[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added Desert boss fight,[/p][/*][*][p]Removed Guardian's Talon weapon from Minerva loot chest[/p][list][*][p]Players can now craft Guardian themed "Feathered" weapons from blacksmith,[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that would cause Minerva's Owl Egg to not respawn,[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Enemies[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added new enemies,[/p][/*][*][p]Updated certain enemy sprites,[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy AI and Combat ability overhaul,[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced chance of spawning raids,[/p][/*][*][p]Buffed aggro ranges,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug causing enemy ranged attacks to not hit players,[/p][/*][*][p]Elite enemies now have unique modifiers and abilities,[/p][/*][*][p]Added new raid,[/p][/*][*][p]Added new creatures to desert biome,[/p][/*][*][p]Rat Buffs,[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Citizens[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added citizen quests,[/p][/*][*][p]New citizen dialogue,[/p][/*][*][p]More variations to citizen appearances,[/p][/*][*][p]Citizens can no longer have contradicting traits,[/p][/*][*][p]Citizens in Insula now walk around interacting with the town,[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Nature & Crops[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added apple trees & seeds,[/p][/*][*][p]Added apricot trees & seeds,[/p][/*][*][p]Added Aloe seeds and farmable Aloe Vera,[/p][/*][*][p]Trees now fall in the opposite direction of where they're struck,[/p][/*][*][p]New seed appearances,[/p][/*][*][p]Changed growth time and appearance for Ember tags.feature: Added Velites as new player profession
Made trees only plantable on dirt tiles
Players can now toggle walking (CAPS LOCK by default)
If spawn point is blocked it moves to a free space
Replaced programmer art with proper art
Catapults now deal siege damage to buildings

tags.balance_change: The blacksmiths level now decides what ores can be smelted

tags.feature: Players can now fast-travel between upgraded altars
Buckets are no longer consumed when building with Clay

tags.balance_change: Major balancing to all combat numbers, Items, and stats

tags.feature: Visual overhaul for all available armours and weapons
Added over **65** new items to loot, craft, or equip!

tags.balance_change: Changed a bunch of crafting recipes
Changed max value possible of coins in inventory
Animal meat is consolidated into three tiers (small, medium, large)

tags.feature: Themed dungeons now guarantee unique loot
Unique armours now drop as schematics for your crafters
Dungeons, PoIs, and challenge dungeons no longer share loot-tables
Biome specific loot tables are even more diverse and separated
Dungeons now spawn in difficulty-appropriate biomes
Removed Guardian's Talon weapon from Minerva loot chest
Players can now craft Guardian themed "Feathered" weapons from blacksmith,

tags.bug: Fixed a bug that would cause Minerva's Owl Egg to not respawn,

tags.balance_change: Enemy AI and Combat ability overhaul,

tags.bug: Fixed bug causing enemy ranged attacks to not hit players,

tags.feature: Elite enemies now have unique modifiers and abilities,
Added new creatures to desert biome,

tags.balance_change: Citizens can no longer have contradicting traits,

tags.feature: Citizens in Insula now walk around interacting with the town,
Added Aloe seeds and farmable Aloe Vera,
Trees now fall in the opposite direction of where they're struck,

tags.balance_change: Changed growth time and appearance for Ember Orchid,

tags.feature: More movable windows (Health bar, chat, notifications),
Player crafting window is now toggleable,
Cauldron and Campfire now require interaction to show crafting window,
Finally, once upgraded, a new tier of progress has been unlocked in the altar! This allows for new building upgrades and recipes!

notes.title: 🔧 Playtest Patch Notes - Alpha 0.18.1_1 🔧
notes.content:
[h2]Change log[/h2]
[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug making all raids potmen raids
[*] Fixed bug causing players to be stuck on "connecting..." in main menu
[*] Made torch statues always point out the closest boss location (rather than the "next" boss)
[*] Damage over Time will no longer cancel "in-progress" actions (like eating)
[/list]

[b]Buildings/Constructions[/b]
[list]
[*] Autoballista changes:
[list]
[*]   Renamed "Automatic Ballista" to "Automatic Scorpio"
[*]   Better targeting for Automatic Scorpio
[*]   Potmen can now be targeted by Automatic Scorpio
[*]   Added upgrades to Auto-Scorpio
[*]   Auto-Scorpio can now be demolished using workbenchs "Demolish Building" tool
[/list]
[*] Added wooden Gates (Horizontal and Vertical)
[*] Carts are now repairable
[*] Fixed clay buckets not syncing properly
[*] Construction sites can now be built with carts in them
[/list]

[b]Enemies[/b]
[list]
[*] increased aggro ranges on the Fallen
[/list]

...and a bunch of other small fixes and tweaks!

Happy Adventuring!

[*] Fixed bug causing players to be stuck on "connecting..." in main menu

[*] Damage over Time will no longer cancel "in-progress" actions (like eating)
[*] Potmen can now be targeted by Automatic Scorpio
[*] Auto-Scorpio can now be demolished using workbenchs "Demolish Building" tool
